tickets.title: Request estate document package
tickets.text: Obtain the current estate document package for Nolan Wrenpuddle. The advisory file contains the 2014 revocable trust and will but not any later restatement, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, or attorney summary letter. Attorney Celia Thimblefern may have prepared a binder after Carla’s death but the finalized contents are unknown.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Address IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Address the IRA beneficiary inconsistency for Nolan Wrenpuddle. The traditional IRA beneficiary confirmation lists Lena and Oscar Wrenpuddle equally, while the Roth IRA confirmation still lists the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary. Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.

tickets.title: Review successor trustee sequence and authority evidence
tickets.text: Review the successor trustee sequence and authority evidence for Nolan Wrenpuddle’s revocable trust. Carla Wrenpuddle is named first successor trustee before his sister Priya Nettlewhisk. Nolan is unsure whether Priya signed any acceptance or whether another child should be added later, which affects the estate review and possible future trust account administration steps.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is also needed by 2026-03-05 on the successor trustee sequence and authority evidence, because Carla remains ahead of Priya and Nolan is unsure whether Priya signed any acceptance or whether another child should be added later;
